commandLine:
source $HOME/.bash_profile;
    folderpath=$(echo '/opt/mhi-ac/gateway/dev2/bloomberg/staging')
    folderpathArchive=$folderpath/archive
    [ -d "$folderpathArchive" ] || mkdir "$folderpathArchive"	
    find $folderpath -maxdepth 1 -name "*.req" -exec mv -f {} $folderpathArchive \;
    
    if [ $UseBusinessDate == 0 ]; then
      cd $AC_SYSTEM/apps/mds-ipv
      $AC_SYSTEM/apps/mds-ipv/app-start.sh -e DEV2 -a "-r"
    else
      cd $AC_SYSTEM/apps/mds-ipv
      $AC_SYSTEM/apps/mds-ipv/app-start.sh -e DEV2 -a "-r -d $BusinessDate"
    fi
